about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/fix (ergo fix). TestFixMigratesModel writes generated modules that the old method-set rule accepts, fixes them and checks them under the declared relation. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants internal/sketch/fix; docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger".

mutants.name: exc1-fix-include-keeps-members
mutants.rule: An include replaces the operations it brings, so a second fix and the checker see one operation each (audit CSX §4.10).
